newsitem.title: USA: Reuters launches North American Power.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches North American Power.

text.p: Reuters America Inc. announced Wednesday the launch of its North American Power real-time news and information service focusing on the U.S. and Canadian power industry.
"The product provides tailored news and market data from the natural gas and electricity markets to meet the information needs of users in those segments," the company said in a statement.

The service will include real-time news from a Reuters team of specialist power reporters, comprehensive prices including cash and futures, historical charting, customised coverage of weather conditions and forecasts, and market statistics, including weekly power production and gas storage.
It aims to serve a wide cross-section of users including utilities, independent power producers, power marketers, industrial consumers, investment banks and energy brokers.
Reuters America Inc. is the primary operating division in the Americas of Reuters Holdings PLC.
